name: @tetherto/mdk-app-agent
description: Auth-gated chat API over the MDK operator agent: sessions, SSE message streams, and approval round-trips for write tools.

setup.prompt: Agent model provider (JSON; point baseURL at a running OpenAI-compatible endpoint, e.g. `./node_modules/.bin/qvac serve openai`. Edit or Enter to accept)
MCP tool server the agent calls fleet tools through (JSON; `mdk run mcp` listens on the Gateway port + 100. Edit or Enter to accept)

routes.description: Opens an agent session bound to the caller's identity.
Streams an agent turn over SSE; write tools pause for an operator's approval.
constraints: Responds as text/event-stream; events carry the gateway wire envelope (turnId, seq, approvalId on pending_approval).

routes.description: Approves or rejects a paused write, resuming or ending the turn.
Deletes a session owned by the caller.
